================================
PRODUCTION TRACKER - QUICK INSTALL
Windows One-Click Installation
================================

EASY INSTALLATION (RECOMMENDED):
---------------------------------

1. Extract this ZIP file to any folder

2. Right-click on "INSTALL.bat"
   Select "Run as Administrator"

3. Follow the prompts - the installer will:
   ✓ Check/install Node.js automatically
   ✓ Install dependencies
   ✓ Copy files to Program Files
   ✓ Install Ableton device
   ✓ Create desktop shortcut
   ✓ (Optional) Add to Windows startup

4. Done! Open Ableton Live and look for "Production Tracker"
   in Max Audio Effect devices

ALTERNATIVE (PowerShell):
-------------------------

1. Right-click on "INSTALL.ps1"
   Select "Run with PowerShell"

MANUAL INSTALLATION:
--------------------

If the automatic installer doesn't work:

1. Install Node.js from https://nodejs.org

2. Double-click "start-bridge.bat" to start the bridge

3. Copy "ProductionTracker.amxd" or "ProductionTracker.maxpat" to:
   %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Ableton\User Library\Presets\Audio Effects\Max Audio Effect\

4. Open Ableton and add the device to Master track

USAGE:
------

1. Start the bridge (double-click desktop shortcut or start-bridge.bat)
2. Open Ableton Live
3. Add "Production Tracker" device to Master track
4. Click "Connect" button
5. Enter auth token from https://muvs.dev/dashboard
6. Start making music!

TROUBLESHOOTING:
----------------

"Access denied" error:
→ Right-click installer and select "Run as Administrator"

Node.js installation fails:
→ Download manually from https://nodejs.org
→ Install, then run INSTALL.bat again

Bridge won't start:
→ Make sure Node.js is installed
→ Check that ports 7400 and 7401 are not in use
→ Try running start-bridge.bat as Administrator

Device not in Ableton:
→ Copy .amxd file manually to User Library
→ Restart Ableton Live

SUPPORT:
--------

Website: https://muvs.dev
Documentation: See README.txt for full details

================================
Happy producing! 🎵
